sources.observation: The official page identifies Xi Omega at Purdue and labels an exterior image Outside Front. Visible architecture includes a large brown-brick, multi-wing house, multiple gabled roof sections, dark shingles, white fascia/window trim, a tall central entry bay with high arched glazing, and dark entry doors.
sources.uncertainty: Photo is oblique and not georeferenced; landscaping/monument sign is separate from building; exact dimensions and hidden elevations unavailable.
